indochina_ai.title: AI features in performances and live translation at the 8th Mekong-Lancang International Film Festival in Vientiane (31 Oct, about 200 attendees from six countries): a digital AI-generated performer sang with human singers, and AI gave live translation in Chinese, Lao and English with technical support from Kunming University of Science and Technology; organisers announced 12 audiovisual cooperation projects including joint translation and short dramas (cultural event, run by Chinese and Lao bodies with Yunnan province as part of a cooperation anniversary week; neutral tech angle, flagged)

'Smart AI for SMEs' programme from the FTI and the Office of Small and Medium Enterprises Promotion, backed by 85 million baht, aims to help 3,000 SME operators across all sectors with practical 'small AI' for accounting, sales, manufacturing and business planning; budget approved in August, money expected later this year, then training and hands-on pilots

FPT and Microsoft hold a Hanoi seminar on AI in software development (4 Nov): shared data says AI raised features shipped by 30% but also raised bugs by 30% and rework by 15% without proper governance; FPT says its Digital Foundry platform cut one US client's defect rate from 30% to 7% (company-reported, vendor event, flagged as promotional)

Prime Minister Hun Manet tells the education and telecom ministries to draft a phased plan for digital technology in schools with reading first, and warns students against using AI to summarise lessons instead of reading and researching across many sources ('when we research a topic, we look at 10 books'); he says tech should aid teachers, not replace teachers and books (leader's remarks on AI in education, neutral, flagged)
